task: Improve the local review assurance CLI diagnostics that were confusing during B-997b closure.
outcome: After running the status commands, the user sees all local review runs instead of an empty default-run view, sees voluntary local 3x2 rounds even when escalation is not required, and DONE stale-material output says exactly which evidence/verdicts are stale plus the next commands to refresh them.
facts: B-997b closure submitted local 3x2 host verdicts using custom run ids, while autopilot_review_status without runId showed default-run only.
review_escalation_status currently returns early when required=false, so voluntary host verdict rounds are not shown.
review assurance floor already rejects stale verdicts and exposes ignored verdict reasons, but the failure text is too dense for operator recovery.
Current story scope is local non-authoritative diagnostics and runbook clarity only; gate predicates and server-backed workflows are out of scope.
constraints: Do not change review assurance pass/fail predicates or DONE completion semantics.
Do not implement future roadmap waves or server-backed proof workflows.
Only modify files inside the execution boundary allowlist.
All checklist items need verificationIntent and fresh verificationEvidence before DONE.
